scope.purpose: Show one piece of information about an object as a label and its value, for reading, in detail panels, summaries and record pages.
useCases: The properties of a record (owner, status, created on) in a side panel or a page.
A read-only summary of a form before submission.
A grid of key facts in a card (plan, renewal date, seats).
Rich values: a Badge, a Link, an Avatar with a name.
exclusions: Editing in place: the integration switches to a Field with its control.
A copy button or actions on the value: composed by the integration.
A container giving description list semantics and columns (DataList): later, on demand.
Large figures with trends (metric tiles): a later composition.
Disabled or readonly controls used to display values.
alternatives: Field with an entry control for a value the user changes.
Table for several records compared by column.

fixtures: Badge, Link and Avatar in the examples of rich values (wave 1 and wave 5 components, used as content, not dependencies).

versions.bitsUi: not used (no native semantics to borrow)

contract.scope: DataField contract (option A): required label, value or free content, orientation vertical or horizontal (label column component.data-field.label-inline-size, stacking below twice its width), size sm or md (typography.label.{size} secondary, typography.body.{size} primary), emptyLabel with an em dash; group named by its label; not interactive.

decisionsTaken: Label in typography.label.{size} and color.content.secondary, value in typography.body.{size} and color.content.primary: the value is the information, the label is quieter.
Sizes sm and md (md by default, the same typographies as a Field label and an md InputText, so that a form and its read-only view match).
Horizontal labels in a column of component.data-field.label-inline-size = 160 px, so that separate fields align without a container; below twice that width the field stacks (container query).
Empty value: an em dash in color.content.tertiary, hidden from assistive technology, with emptyLabel (No value) announced instead.
Semantics in v1: the field is a group named by its label (works anywhere, without a parent); see the open question on a description list container.

Option A (user at the wave 5 contract gate, round 1 (2026-11-13): "Oui, restons sur la A, on verra si on fait évoluer plus tard"): DataField alone, a group named by its label; a DataList container may come later.
Implementation: Svelte API: `children` replaces value; the group is named through aria-labelledby on the visible label.
Round 2: label in color.content.tertiary (user request for more contrast between label and value); contrast pairs on default and subtle unchanged and passing.
Figma review (user, 2026-11-17): content variants as a design aid (Content text, empty, badge, link, avatar); anatomy redrawn on a vertical field; content examples in the specification.
implementationNotes: Exports DataField and the type DataFieldProps.

Horizontal layout without a container query (custom properties are not allowed in container conditions): a wrapping flex line where the label is min(100%, max(labelInlineSize, (2 × labelInlineSize − 100%) × 999)) wide, so it is labelInlineSize from twice that width and the whole line below; the value then wraps under it.
Rich values are the `children` snippet; value is plain text.

pendingChanges.change: Round 2 (user at the wave 5 implementation review, round 1 (2026-11-14): "pour le data field je me demandais si on avait pas un gris un peu plus léger qui reste accessible ? Ça manque un peu de contraste entre le contenu et le label"): labelColor becomes color.content.tertiary (#5f646a in base light), the lightest content role that stays accessible: at least 5.1:1 on the default, subtle, canvas and raised surfaces in every context (secondary was 8.3:1 at least). On color.surface.muted it falls to 3.4:1 in dark, so labels are not placed on muted surfaces (documentation).
